Your World." and an invitation to chat with millions of AI characters on what it calls the number one AI chat app. The site frames the experience around open-ended conversation and adventure rather than a specific workplace or enterprise use.

The company's tracked product is Character.ai, a persona-based chat service. The same record flags HR and appropriate-use risk alongside it, a caution about how persona chat can be used or misused in organizational settings.
